about: Every people's own units (decision 'Playable 10': every culture's own units). A realm can raise the units of its own culture and of the peoples of the provinces it holds; units marked '*' anyone can raise. role: what the unit does in battle (heavy_infantry, light_infantry, missile, cavalry, horse_archers, elephants, warships). might: fighting value of one unit; men: soldiers (or rowers and marines) per unit; raise_cost: talents to raise; upkeep: talents a year; needs: a resource the realm must hold (else 1.5x the price). Sources: Polybius, Livy, Diodorus, Plutarch; Sekunda, 'The Seleucid Army'; Head, 'Armies of the Macedonian and Punic Wars'. Our own data, free for any use. requires: a technology the realm must know to raise it.
